name: 86 Chaos 17.0.13
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.13
notes: Makes the one-paste release workflow safely resumable when a previous attempt already overlaid the same or immediately preceding release into the repository before stopping.
Verifies a dirty pre-existing candidate against its own release-source manifest before any overlay, refusing unknown user edits while allowing a coherent interrupted release to continue.
Removes stale source files only when they are proven members of the verified prior release manifest and are absent from the incoming release.

Preserves the 17.0.12 hostile source-identity regression repair, 17.0.11 Schedule Builder/Firebase referrer repairs, immutable deployment certification, no-pager behavior, and full-gate-only user testing flow.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.13
summary: Repairs the one-paste updater so interrupted release installs can resume safely instead of misclassifying an already-overlaid candidate as the next version.
description: Adds manifest-verified idempotent resume behavior to the automatic install, commit, deploy, and full Play Store workflow without weakening dirty-repository protection or deployment identity.
